description: Returns one obligation's (section's) verbatim regulator text with provenance. Inputs: `obligation_id`; optional `offset`, `limit`, `compare_versions`. `verbatim` holds the text between <<<BEGIN VERBATIM>>> and <<<END VERBATIM>>>. `canonical_citation` is the section's citation in the regulator's style (e.g. "4000.1 II.A.5.d", "B3-3.3-07", "38 U.S.C. 3709(b)"), or null. Paging: at most 24,000 chars per response; `chars_offset` + `chars_returned` is the position within `chars_total`; `next_offset` is the offset of the next page, or null when the section ends in this response; `truncated` means more text follows; `started_mid_section` means text before `chars_offset` is not included; `paging` gives page N of M. `currency` is null or a version/status signal (dual-version, pending, revision-pending, superseded, expired...) with a one-line `headline`. An FHA 4000.1 section HUD's Update 18 revises has two obligations, the in-force text and the revision (`<id>::update-18`); `version` says which this is and `other_version` identifies the other. `compare_versions: true` adds `version_changes`, the sentences Update 18 deletes and adds. `figures` is a best-effort extraction of figures in the text; an empty or incomplete list is not evidence that the text states no figure. `canonical_id`, when set, is the register this one is a same-text copy of.

compare_versions.description: On an FHA section Update 18 revises: also return `version_changes`, the sentences Update 18 deletes and adds (verbatim units with offsets).

limit.description: Max chars to return from offset (200-24000; default 24000).

name: get_obligation

authority.description: The document and section title as published.

canonical_citation.description: The citation in the regulator's style (e.g. "4000.1 II.A.5.d", "B3-3.3-07"), or null.

canonical_id.description: Set when this register is a same-text copy of that register.

chars_offset.description: Where this response starts in the section's text.

chars_returned.description: Characters of text in this response.

coverage_tier.description: How completely the corpus holds the document.

currency.description: null, or a version/status signal {kind, headline, detail, effective_date, mandatory_date, expires_on, as_of, links}; kind e.g. dual-version, pending, revision-pending, superseded, superseded-in-part, modified-by, expired.

editorial.description: Reserved; summary is null (the text is not summarized).

error.description: Present only on an error or refusal: not_found, ambiguous, unparsed, empty_terms, unknown_playbook, unknown_reference, offset_out_of_range, daily_capacity_reached.

fallback.description: On daily_capacity_reached: where the full corpus can be downloaded.

figures.description: Best-effort extraction of figures in the text; an empty or incomplete list is not evidence that the text states no figure.

as_written.description: The figure as written, when it differs.

unit.description: percent, percentage_point, currency, duration, ratio, fraction, age, day_of_period, time, count, number or temperature.

value.description: The figure as a number string, e.g. "43", "50/50".

guidance.description: On a refusal or empty search: the server's explanation.

hint.description: On an error: the server's explanation.

next_offset.description: The next page's offset, or null when the section ends here.

notice.description: Terms notice: research use only, not legal advice.

other_version.description: On a dual-version section: the other version ({obligation_id, version, dates}).

page_url.description: The section's page on claudeforcompliance.com (verbatim text, currency notices, link to the regulator).

next_offset.description: The next page's offset, or null at the end.

page.description: This page's number, or null past the end.

pages.description: Total pages at this page size.

resets.description: On daily_capacity_reached: when capacity resets (00:00 UTC).

resolved_from_alias.description: The retired obligation id requested; its text is now at obligation_id.

source_url.description: The regulator's URL for the document.

started_mid_section.description: Text before chars_offset is not in this response.

verbatim.description: The regulator's exact text, between <<<BEGIN VERBATIM>>> and <<<END VERBATIM>>>.

version.description: On a dual-version section: {label: in-force | update-18-optional, dates, note}.

version_changes.description: With compare_versions: sentences Update 18 deletes and adds, or {error: "single_version"}.
